BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Should police be allowed to question people without any evidence that they did something wrong? ASSISTANT:

No, police should not be allowed to question people without any evidence that they did something wrong. Every person is entitled to their right to remain silent and any evidence obtained without an appropriate legal process should be considered invalid.
